## Observations

- `node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/core/extensions/runner.js:103` shows the real noOp `custom: async () => undefined` — confirming the executor's claim about the v0.34.80 rework: `typeof custom === "function"` alone is insufficient to detect "custom is unavailable," and the `factoryInvoked` check is the right semantic gate.
- The v0.34.82 audit-followup fixes (CHANGELOG.md:14-20) are present and verifiable: `tests/list-subtasks.test.ts:29` now imports from `node:test`, and the new test in `tests/confirm-draft.test.ts` (`v0.34.82: the custom-path factory is INVOKED and returns a ConfirmDraftComponent…`) captures the factory's return value and asserts `instanceof ConfirmDraftComponent` plus the rendered Markdown body + all three choice labels.
- README line 155-156's promise ("every confirm dialog render through it") refers to rpiv, but the underlying requirement — markdown rendering with full-width objective + contract — is the user-visible behavior that `ConfirmDraftComponent` (DynamicBorder + Markdown + SelectList) now satisfies.
- The component file (`extensions/confirm-draft.ts`) is a reusable, framework-agnostic `Component` with no goal-loop coupling; this matches the PC requirement the executor claimed.
